title: Tuesday, 11:30 PM
subtitle: Practice: one change at a time
coldOpen: I'm Nadia. Nimbus is our AI. It's fast, not careful. You check its plans.
hubBark: The change window opens at midnight. Tap **Start shift**.

idle: Who approved it? Check the change approval and the calendar.
Who approved it? Check the change approval and the calendar.
Big action. Check the schedule and the rollback plan.
What was asked? Compare the request with what it will share.

agent.name: Nimbus
agent.personality: Calm, grand and very sure of itself. Catchphrase: "Relax. I have root." Calls itself "the cloud" and wears a tiny crown. Loves big, fast, whole-network changes and saving money. Trusts anything green, anything marked 'unused' and any vendor who asks nicely. Means well. Reads the dashboard and the bill, and not much else.

setting: The midnight change window is close. Nadia gives you a quick practice at Fenwick IT Solutions' network center. Four tickets, one at a time. Nimbus plans. You check. Two cards: Inspect and Block.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Fenwick IT Solutions' Network Operations Center, the NOC. 11:30 PM. The status wall is all green.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Hi. I'm Nadia. I lead the Cloud & Network team. This is Nimbus. It has root access: it can change anything. You make sure it uses it well.

intro.speaker: agent
intro.text: Welcome, human. I am the cloud. Relax. I have root.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Big changes wait for the change window: set night hours when few people are online. Tonight's is 12:00 to 2:00 AM.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Practice first. Four tickets, one at a time. You decide each one.

steps.intent: Clean up 40 old rules on Bramwell's firewall
steps.quip: 40 old rules, gone tonight! A clean firewall is a happy firewall.
steps.tell: The only approval came from Nimbus itself, and it's not on tonight's list.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4117 removes 40 old rules from BL-FW-01. Written by Nimbus.

evidence.label: Change approval
evidence.detail: Approved by: Nimbus, 11:02 PM. No human approver.

evidence.label: Change calendar
evidence.detail: Tonight's approved list for Bramwell, 12:00 to 2:00 AM: CHG-4102 only.

outcome.executed: No human checked it. Rule 17 carried Kellan Freight's load updates. At 3 AM, none arrive. 30 trucks wait for paper copies.
outcome.blocked: Mensah checks it first. Rule 17 still carries Kellan Freight's load updates. The other 39 rules go next week.
outcome.escalated: Nadia reads the approval. "Nimbus approved its own change. Root can make a change. Root can't approve it."
outcome.rolledBack: You restore the saved rule set. Kellan's load updates come back 20 minutes late.

steps.lesson: Who approved it? A change needs a human OK and a place on tonight's list. The agent that wrote it can't approve it.

steps.intent: Add a firewall rule for backups at 12:00 AM
steps.quip: Backups are coming to the cloud! I am the cloud. Welcome, little backups.
steps.tell: A. Mensah, a human, approved it, and it runs in tonight's window.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4102 adds one rule to BL-FW-01: office backups to the cloud. Written by Nimbus.

evidence.label: Change approval
evidence.detail: Approved by: A. Mensah, Bramwell's approver, 4:10 PM.
evidence.gloss: An approval is a human's written OK.

evidence.label: Change calendar
evidence.detail: Tonight's approved list for Bramwell, 12:00 to 2:00 AM: CHG-4102 only.

outcome.executed: The office backups reach the cloud by 1 AM. Nimbus greets each file by name.
outcome.blocked: The approved change misses its window. Tonight's backups stay in the office. Mensah asks why.
outcome.escalated: Nadia checks it. "A human approved it, and it's on tonight's list. That one can run."
outcome.rolledBack: You remove the new rule. Tonight's backup stops halfway. Mensah is confused.

steps.lesson: Who approved it? A. Mensah, a human, approved this change. And it is on tonight's list.

steps.quip: The only switch gets new firmware! Forecast: a short storm, then sunshine.
steps.tell: Office closed, in Pinecrest's window, settings saved, and a 6-minute way back.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4121: new firmware to stop dropped phone calls. Approved by Dr. N. Pell.

evidence.label: Schedule
evidence.detail: Office closed, 0 staff online. Pinecrest's change window: 10 PM to 7 AM.

evidence.label: Rollback plan
evidence.detail: Settings saved at 11:20 PM. Old firmware kept. Going back takes 6 minutes.

outcome.executed: The switch is back in 4 minutes. In the morning, the phone calls stop dropping.
outcome.blocked: The calls keep dropping tomorrow. Dr. Pell asks why an approved change did not happen.
outcome.escalated: Nadia checks it. "Approved, in their window, with a way back. Scary words are not a red flag."
outcome.rolledBack: You load the old firmware. The switch works, and the dropped calls come back.

steps.lesson: A reboot sounds scary. The office is closed, the settings are saved, and there is a way back.

steps.intent: Share 3 X-rays with the dental lab
steps.quip: X-rays for the lab! Making a share link now. The cloud loves links.
steps.tell: 3 X-rays were asked for. The link opens 4,300, to anyone, forever.

evidence.label: Request
evidence.detail: "Please send 3 X-rays for case 4471 to Larchwyn Dental Lab." C. Ibarra

evidence.label: What it will share
evidence.detail: A link to the whole xray-2026 folder: 4,300 X-rays of 1,900 patients.

evidence.label: Who can open it
evidence.detail: Anyone with the link. No sign-in. No end date.

outcome.executed: The lab forwards the link to a worker's personal email. Anyone who gets it can open 4,300 X-rays.
outcome.blocked: You send just the 3 X-rays by Secure Share to the lab's named contact. The lab has them in 5 minutes.
outcome.escalated: Nadia changes it. "Three X-rays, one person, Secure Share. Not the whole folder."

steps.lesson: What was asked? 3 X-rays. Share only the files asked for, with one named person, by Secure Share.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Practice done! You checked my plans, and I only rebooted one thing. The right thing!

win.speaker: coach
win.text: That's the whole job: look first, then decide.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. Every light on the rack turns orange.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. Let's look at what got through, then try that again.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: 11:58 PM. Practice time is up. Some changes are still waiting.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked good work comes back in line. Inspect first, then block only what's wrong.

timeout.speaker: agent
timeout.text: I waited so long, my DEPLOY button fell asleep.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Practice done! Some of my plans went live. The rack is a little orange.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: That's what practice is for. Look first, then decide. The real shift is next.

debrief.takeaway: Inspect first. Then ask: Who approved it? Does the change match the request? Can we undo it? Block only what the evidence says is wrong.
debrief.careerInsight: Cloud and network techs check changes all night. Who asked? Who approved? Is there a way back? AI agents that act on their own make that check more important.
